correctness.rationale: For any nonempty binary pattern the earliest greedy endpoint in infinite abab... equals L=k+[first=b]+[equal-adjacent pairs]. Direct calculation of endpoint losses under first, interior and last deletion proves the exhaustive MAS classification, including L=2m+1 or 2m+2. Run grammar with first-run and internal-run constraints yields F(u,z), and a last-letter append bijection gives H=uz^2F. Coefficient extraction gives B_m(u); recurrence and generating function follow algebraically. An included standalone checker directly tests every candidate through m=7 and separately recomputes bivariate series coefficients. These finite tests corroborate, but do not replace, the all-m proof.

value.rationale: All-m exact MAS classification of the natural even alternating binary family gives both the complete length distribution and the exact cubic recurrence for the number of forbidden minimal scattered patterns. This reveals a genuinely nontrivial run grammar and exponential growth hidden by general output enumeration methods, and offers an exact benchmark for subsequence-index and automaton experiments. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or an incremental table extension.
